description: A white AirPods charging case and a short white charging cable are lying on a green cloth surface in front of the hands. The right hand moves in from the right and steadies the AirPods case as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches in from the left to pick up the cable tip and guide it toward the case; the left hand then pushes the connector into the charging port so the cable becomes a left-hand object while the case remains held by the right hand.
